comment: Professor Abdo is so nice and sweet. I liked her class, although it wasn't very intellectually stimulating. The papers, tests, and quizzes are all easy and mostly open note. Definitely take!
Very sweet professor. I enjoyed her class and Professor is always available for help. Very understanding as well. Would definitely take again!

Dr. Abdo is a great prof. You have weekly open note quizzes, a health policy brief, and a final exam in the class. Homework on Blackboard is optional; you do not have to do readings.  The final exam and the health policy brief are super easy. Participate, though; it's a big part of your grade. (Also, A+ is from 99-100, which is annoying)
